_note: Real, well-known places for the anime and regional layers. Coordinates are approximate.

anime.name: Akihabara Electric Town
anime.note: Anime, manga, figure and game shops across whole buildings.

anime.name: Ghibli Museum, Mitaka
anime.note: Studio Ghibli's museum. Tickets sell out, so book weeks ahead.

anime.name: Nakano Broadway
anime.note: A vintage mall full of collectors' shops.

anime.name: Kamakura-Kōkōmae crossing
anime.note: The seaside railway crossing fans know from Slam Dunk.

anime.name: Kyoto International Manga Museum
anime.note: A former school with walls of manga you can read.

anime.name: Hida-Furukawa
anime.note: A quiet town fans visit for scenes from the film Your Name.

regional.name: Shirakawa-go
regional.note: UNESCO village of thatched gassho-style farmhouses.

regional.name: Kinosaki Onsen
regional.note: Stroll between seven public bathhouses in a yukata.

regional.name: Naoshima
regional.note: An island of art museums and outdoor sculptures.
